symbols.name: field width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two fields being interchanged.
symbols.quote: Write $u$ for the number of bits in each of the two fields being interchanged.

relations.predicate: is a run of bits in
relations.quote: An address field is a run of bits in the [address](address.md) of an array
Each address field is moved by a [permutation](permutation.md) of addresses, because the interchange exchanges only the fields and not the entries' values.
